text:
The goat scratches until hurt; the pitcher goes to the well until it breaks; iron heats until red; it is struck until split; a man is worth as much as he is prized; he goes so far he is forgotten; becomes so bad he is despised; Christmas is invoked until it comes.

One speaks until contradicting himself; good fame is worth as much as favor gained; one promises until retracting; pleads until the thing is won; it is loved more the more it is sought; sought until found; more frequent the less desired; Christmas is invoked until it comes.

The dog is loved until fed; the song travels until learned; fruit is kept until rotten; a place besieged until conquered; delay ruins the venture; haste brings harm; one squeezes until the prize falls; Christmas is invoked until it comes.

One jokes until no laughter comes; spends until shirtless; gives so freely all is spent; taking is worth as much as promise; God is loved until church is followed; one gives until borrowing is needed; wind turns until north wind; Christmas is invoked until it comes.

Prince, a fool lives until cured, goes until returning, is beaten until changing his mind, Christmas is invoked until it comes.
